title: Persisting Quality in Agentic Workflows

# Persisting Quality in Agentic Workflows

Software development is evolving rapidly. With the rise of agentic AI assistants, developers can scaffold entire structures in seconds. However, this raises a new challenge: **how do we maintain software quality in automated loops?**

## The Speed vs. Knowledge Dilemma

AI can write code faster than any human, but it doesn't automatically understand the trade-offs of architecture decisions. If you rely too heavily on AI without possessing strong foundational knowledge, you risk introducing subtle, hard-to-debug architectural flaws.

> "I want AI to help me pursue my dreams and passions, not to take those dreams away from me."

## Best Practices for Agentic Pairs

1. **Maintain Strict CI/CD Gates**: Never let code enter production without passing automated static analysis, security scans, and unit tests.
2. **Type Safety is King**: Use strongly-typed languages like TypeScript on the frontend and backend to catch reference issues immediately.
3. **Domain-Driven Modular Monoliths**: By structuring code into clean domain boundaries, you limit the impact of code modifications and keep applications easy to maintain.
